src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkMcp.c.name: AI assistant connection
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/CluckworkMcp.c.description: Opens the /mcp door where connected AI assistants call farm tools, accepting only approved app tokens.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/McpToolErrors..name: AI tool error messages
src/Cluckwork.Api/Hosting/McpToolErrors..description: Turns tool failures into clear messages for the assistant without leaking internal details.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/CommerceTools.cs.name: Sales tools
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/CommerceTools.cs.description: Lets an assistant look up customers, sales orders, payments and balances.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/DailyEntryTools.cs.name: Daily entry tools
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/DailyEntryTools.cs.description: Lets an assistant read daily egg entries and record or submit one.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/ExpenseTools.cs.name: Expense tools
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/ExpenseTools.cs.description: Lets an assistant record an expense, only for people allowed to handle money.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/FlockTools.cs.name: Flock tools
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/FlockTools.cs.description: Lets an assistant list flocks, showing workers only their own.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/InventoryTools.cs.name: Inventory tools
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/InventoryTools.cs.description: Lets an assistant record feed use, water use and supply purchases.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpCallContext.cs.name: Caller identity for tools
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpCallContext.cs.description: Tells each tool who is calling and for which farm.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpMoney.cs.name: Money formatting for AI
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpMoney.cs.description: Writes amounts as exact decimal text in the farm's currency so assistants do not misread them.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpNames.cs.name: Name matching for AI
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpNames.cs.description: Lets an assistant refer to a supply item or expense category by name or ID, matching names exactly but ignoring capitals.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpPage.cs.name: Tool result pages
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpPage.cs.description: Shapes the reply of every read tool into a page of results.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpWrite.cs.name: Safe tool writes
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/McpWrite.cs.description: Runs every write tool through the same once-only save protection used by the app.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/MirrorsRouteAttrib.name: Tool matches web address
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/MirrorsRouteAttrib.description: Marks which web address a tool mirrors, so a test can confirm it is not more permissive.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/StockTools.cs.name: Stock tools
src/Cluckwork.Api/Mcp/StockTools.cs.description: Lets an assistant read egg stock and the batches and movements behind it.
